name: Masters Kit Presse
description: Reads a website's brand (colors, fonts, logos, tone), checks contrast and derives a dark and a light palette, then builds two reusable masters to present a digital product to the press, bloggers and influencers: a 16:9 deck (Google Slides or .pptx, 17 slides with filling notes) and a document (Google Docs or .docx) combining a press release, a creators brief and a Q&A. Standard launch outline, {{FIELD}} placeholders, no invented product content.
